headlines: AI/chip rout continues: NVDA -8.9%, MU -15.3%, AMD -15.6%, SNDK -19.9%, TSLA -11.8%, SOXL -32.7%, QQQ -6.0% (Stocktwits trending)
SPY 734 (-4.2%), IWM -4.4%, QQQ RSI ~29, SPY RSI ~38; Stocklake fear and greed 20 (extreme fear); 6.9% of stocks oversold
Gold +0.9%, TLT +0.4% as money rotates to safety
US nonfarm payrolls tomorrow 13:30 UTC (prior 29, unemployment prior 4.2); Mexico rate decision 19:00 UTC today; ADP yesterday 86 vs 90

rumors.text: Posters blame the Democratic midterm result for expected limits on the AI buildout
rumors.why: If policy fears persist, AI-heavy index weights keep dragging SPY and QQQ

rumors.text: Posters say much of the fall is forced selling by over-leveraged institutions holding AI names
rumors.why: Forced liquidation could overshoot into the close, then reverse

rumors.text: Posters talk of a market circuit breaker coming and ask if SPY can reach -5%
rumors.why: Panic framing; a halt needs about -7%, roughly 3% further down

rumors.text: Posters link the selloff to Iran war worries
rumors.why: Unverified geopolitical claim; if true would add risk-off pressure

rumors.text: Poster notes SPY is about 1% above its 200-day average; a break could extend the fall
rumors.why: Breaking a key moving average can trigger more technical selling

plays.reason: -4.2% day, extreme fear 20, QQQ RSI ~29 and breadth washed out often give a partial bounce; payrolls tomorrow is a risk
plays.catalyst: Oversold bounce vs payrolls 13:30 UTC tomorrow

plays.reason: Price still near day lows with no reversal; coin flip
plays.catalyst: Possible forced selling into the close

readings.whats_new: SPY slipped to about -4.2% from -4.1% last hour, hugging the 734 low. Chip losses are similar to last hour (NVDA -9%, MU -15%, AMD -16%); fear and greed about 20 and Stocktwits SPY sentiment 29, both little changed. New chatter is about forced institutional selling, Iran war worries and the 200-day average about 1% away. Reddit blocked; web search found no same-day coverage.
